subject: ACE onboarding and marketplace listing — Aurora Health
messages:
From: John Doe <john.doe@aurorahealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Exploring AWS ACE + Marketplace listing for Aurora Health

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the latency profile and cost controls looked promising for our patient-facing clinical summarization workflow. Our business and procurement teams asked me to start the ACE registration and marketplace listing conversation so we can evaluate co-sell potential with AWS.

High level:
- We aim to list a managed integration (SaaS) that will surface summaries and embedding-based search for clinicians.
- Target pilot: Jan 2027 with a handful of hospital systems.

Can you introduce the right PDM/PSM on your side and share an initial mutual action plan (MAP) and a short checklist of evidence AWS typically needs (SOC 2, PCI if any, architecture diagram)? Procurement also expects a preliminary commercial outline for AWS co-sell.

Attaching a short SOW that describes the pilot scope.

Thanks,
John
John Doe
Head of Partnerships, Aurora Health
[Attachment: Aurora_MVP_SOW.pdf (pdf)]
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exploring AWS ACE + Marketplace listing for Aurora Health

John — great to hear and thanks for the SOW. Looping in Marissa (PDM) and Karthik (PSM) to coordinate ACE registration, AWS co-sell alignment, and the marketplace listing.

Next steps I recommend this week:
1) Quick intro call (30m) to align scope and roles — propose Thu 12/2 10:00am PT.
2) We’ll send an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps out ACE registration tasks, AWS docs, and owner assignments.
3) Karthik will collect the security artifacts you referenced; Marissa will own the product listing details and catalog metadata.

I’ve attached a draft MAP and added the SOW to the sheet so we can track tasks. Please confirm the 12/2 slot or suggest alternatives.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Strategic GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW-Aurora-MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@aurorahealth.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ACE onboarding and marketplace listing — Aurora Health

Hi John / Sofia — thanks for the intro. A few logistical items from the PDM side to help the listing and co-sell motion move quickly:

Technical/Listing check (initial):
- Confirm SaaS deployment model (hosted by Redwood? customer-managed VPC?) — affects marketplace SKU and listing copy.
- Minimum feature set for pilot (we mapped a subset in the SOW, please confirm): clinician search, note summarization, audit logs.
- Estimated monthly token volume for pilot (this will inform SKU sizing and cost estimates).

Security/evidence:
- SOC 2 Type II snapshot (attached) and our data handling brief. If you have any regional data residency requirements please flag them.

Marketplace steps we’ll own:
- Draft listing copy and product tile
- Fill AWS ACE registration form (I’ll coordinate with Karthik on the business & commercial fields)
- Set up the AWS co-sell intake once ACE registration is submitted

I attached our SOC2 snapshot and an architecture diagram that we can adapt for the listing. I’ll prepare a short kickoff agenda for Thu (30m) that covers roles, MAP milestones, and the ACE form owners.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: architecture-diagram.png (png)]

John / team — I’ll take point on the ACE form and the AWS co-sell intake. Quick operational notes ahead of our 12/2 call:

1) Commercial placeholder: please confirm anticipated ARR bands for pilot -> production (helps AWS route the right GTM resources). A pink-sheet estimate is fine for now.
2) Required artifacts I’ll upload with the ACE registration: SOC2 snapshot, architecture diagram, contact list (sales/tech/ops), and a short product description. Please send procurement contact details if we need to route contract questions.
3) Proposed agenda for Thu (30m): introductions, MAP milestones + owners, artifacts checklist & deadlines, listing timeline (draft tile -> AWS review -> publish).

I’ve created a shared MAP in Drive (link below) and added action owners against each line item. If the 12/2 10:00am PT slot works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include an AWS ACE checklist in the invite notes.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Partnerships Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
[Drive MAP: https://drive.redwood.ai/sheets/RDW-Aurora-MAP]
